subject.title: fix(proxy): add error handler on upstream response stream

question: Should the debug proxy normalize upstream request and response failures to a generic 502 before headers and a destroyed downstream response after headers, replacing the old raw-error-body response for request-level upstream failures?
rationale: The patch fixes a real crash path, but it also changes client-visible failure semantics in a debug proxy, which is a compatibility contract choice rather than a purely mechanical code decision.

options.title: Accept generic failure contract
options.body: Land this shape once exact-head checks are green, making the debug proxy avoid leaking upstream error text and terminate partial responses honestly.

options.title: Preserve raw diagnostic body
options.body: Ask for a revision that keeps raw upstream error text for request-level failures while still adding the missing upstream response stream error listener.

options.title: Pause until proxy owner review
options.body: Leave the PR open until the proxy-capture owner decides the failure contract and validation scope.

recommendation.title: Accept generic failure contract
recommendation.body: Land this shape once exact-head checks are green, making the debug proxy avoid leaking upstream error text and terminate partial responses honestly.
